race.comment: KICKING HORSE (9) comes here fresh from a fifth a week-and-a-half ago over 2138m at this track, beaten 14 metres. Quality performer who is perfectly placed to bounce back. DESIRING DIAMONDS (4) was an impressive winner last start over 2138m at this track, getting home by 2 metres. Drawn well so another win will not surprise. KYOKUSHIN BEAR (6) was an impressive winner last start over 2138m at this track, getting home by 7 metres. Another big performance is on the cards. NONIS GOLD CLASS (3) found one better last start over 2138m at this track, beaten 2 metres. Ideally drawn and can play a big role.
